title: The Eight-Step Mystery
learning_focus: At least eight events; main idea and summary; perfect tenses; author purpose/message/audience; possible ending; conclusion; vicarious learning; punctuation clues; almanac; compound-complex sentences; cultural appropriateness.
story_premise: Eight carved markers around a festival route tell the story of a lost community promise. The last marker is blank, and different endings are possible.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: At least eight events; main idea and summary; perfect tenses; author purpose/message/audience; possible ending; conclusion; vicarious learning; punctuation clues; almanac; compound-complex sentences; cultural appropriateness.
